mechanism.claim: The median standardized canonical-dollar return across six major FX pairs is a robust continuous global dollar factor. An unusually large factor during high BTC variation transmits inversely into BTC for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: opposite the strict sign of the median six-pair standardized canonical-dollar return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVDBR-12 requires five-of-six sign breadth and a median absolute pair shock and is terminal. DFSR uses a continuous median factor and a strict-prior rank of its own absolute value, with no breadth count or HVDBR control promotion. MXRBR and SERBR use individual or two-pair beta residuals.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the completed pre-entry 24-hour BTC realized variation must be in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one sparse 21:05 UTC weekday macro clock is absent from Gross9 primitives

features.fx_session: bars_polygon interval=1m rows for EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDAUD, USDCAD, USDCHF, and USDJPY with 13:00<=UTC time<21:00 on one UTC weekday
features.fx_session_valid: at least 450 distinct observed minutes, first timestamp no later than 13:05, last timestamp no earlier than 20:55, finite positive OHLC; no imputation
features.canonical_dollar_returns: negative session log return for EURUSD and GBPUSD; positive session log return for USDAUD, USDCAD, USDCHF, and USDJPY
features.pair_zscores: each canonical dollar return standardized against its own at most 90 strictly prior valid sessions, minimum 60, current excluded; prior sample std positive
features.dollar_factor: cross-sectional median of six finite pair z-scores; strict nonzero
features.factor_abs_rank: strict-prior midrank of absolute dollar factor against at most 90 prior valid sessions, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.70
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum of squared completed-hour BTC log returns over the 24 hours ending at decision time)
features.volatility_rank: strict-prior midrank against at most 90 valid decision days, minimum 60; current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: exact weekday D 21:00 UTC after the FX session and BTC variation are complete
clock.reservation: fixed weekday decisions; global half-open, exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium_implied_vol: not signal inputs; exact funding only for later PnL

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.completed_btc: hash-bound completed-hour BTC source through 2026-08-01 for pre-entry variation only
source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent continuous global-dollar-factor transmission mechanism for volatile BTC regimes

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no factor, rank, side, hold, clock, session, or subset repair.
